Dear Bernic:
Yesterday, Amir, Mike and I further discussed how we could go about providing Potential Indices
(PIs) and providing Market Share Adjusted (MSA) PIs in response to Jeanne Lincoin's request
made to you carlier this month. As you are aware from our meeting at Market Metrics last week,
we thought we had worked out a means to accomplish this by the first week in April. During that
discussion we did, however, present two reservations:
First, although much data validation could be completed by this time, we were all concerned
about delivering production/business ready (ocrtified) data in the midst of system development.
Second, we discussed the fact that Market Metrics had redeveloped the CTS profiles in
January/February and that we were planning to insert them into IRDD during the 1995
Demographic update in April. These profiles were reprocessed to take advantage of Charlie
Getchell's newest approach to regional profile development, Without this modification, brands
of lower penetration would not be properly demographically represented. Please note the
profiles existing in RDM I are not impacted by this because that set is not regionalized.
It is this last concen which prevents us from being able to certify PIs and MSA PIs calculated on
the current IRDD CTS profiles.
In summary, the data requested by PM could be availabie at the end of April when the pre
generated data will be based on the new profiles. Or, if PM approves an interruption in the current
IRDD schedule, we could take approximately three weeks to load the new profiles and generate all
the PIs and MSA PIs. Then in April, we would turn around and re-do this work after the 1995
Demography is placed in IRDD. The exact impact to the schedule would need to be modeled
through the project management software before we could advise PM.
I hope this helps to clarify our concerns.
Sipcerely,
Ann P. Raezer
P.S. Copies are being sent to PM per Tim Gourley's request due to the representation of this issue
on the Issues List.
